notes.title: Manalith v1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
A few minor updates and additions for this first update to Manalith:

[h3]Added[/h3]

[list]
[*] The "Collection" tab in the in-game menu now has tooltips for the various items
[*] An option has been added in the in-game menu to disable the screen flash effect when activating Manaliths or collecting items
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]

[list]
[*] A couple of underwater sections near the edges of the map were not triggering swimming movement and underwater VFX correctly
[*] The interaction prompt will no longer be displayed for portals you have already activated
[*] Changes to sound and music volume from the in-game menu were not saved unless you also applied graphics settings
[*] One item did not correctly register on the "Collection" tab of the in-game menu
[*] Sealed up a small gap where you could fall below the ground near the canyon
[/list]
